**Chinese name:** 圣邦微电子（北京）股份有限公司 (Shèngbāng)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
China's closest analogue to TI's broadline model and — by 2025 revenue — the #1 domestic analog supplier and #8 worldwide (1.8% share, Frost & Sullivan): FY2025 revenue ¥38.98亿 (+16.5%), H1 2026 ¥25.95亿 (+42.7%) on optical-module/AI-server demand, with net profit ¥4.20亿 (+109.3%) and Q2 revenue ¥14.97亿 a record. The A+H listing (26 June 2026, 3661.HK at HK$85.20; greenshoe fully exercised 23 July, ~HK$5.3bn combined) makes it the consolidation vehicle for Chinese analog — tuck-ins so far are 感睿智能 (magnetic sensing, 67%) and 亿存芯 (EEPROM, 77.5%), with no new deal announced by October; ADI/TI price hikes landing September 2026 give the domestic analog complex pricing cover.
:::

## What does this firm design?

General-purpose and application-specific analog/mixed-signal ICs across consumer, industrial, automotive and now datacenter power/optical markets.

## Key Facts

| | |
|---|---|
| **Category** | Fabless |
| **Founded** | 2007 |
| **Location** | Beijing, Beijing Municipality |
| **Product Focus** | Broadline analog: signal chain (amps, ADC/DAC, interface) + power management (LDO, DC-DC, AMOLED, battery) — 7,200+ SKUs across 38 categories |
| **Node Sophistication** | Mature specialty analog nodes; high-end parts include 140dB log amps, 24-bit ADCs, 120V monitoring AFE, GaN drivers, automotive 100V buck controllers |
